draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact exactly as given, serialize it as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace, persist the exact bytes as proposal_canon.json, then compute hProposal = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json); the seed is derived as seedHex = SHA-256(hProposal + salt) (with the engine-provided hProposal and salt), so a third party can re-derive the same seed by hashing the same canonical proposal_canon.json bytes and applying the same SHA-256(hProposal + salt) step.
